summary: 45 features and 20 fixes across HagiCode-org/hagicode-core, HagiCode-org/web.
bodyHtml:
Features

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • session-proposals: import unlinked OpenSpec changes (dd42a1a)
  • hero-avatars: ship provider-themed character packs (75b6984)
  • hero-avatars: add bulk avatar rotation controls (5ee4839)
  • hero-avatars: support variable pack sizes and Claude defaults (5ff9112)
  • user-skills: load registered skills in place for agent CLIs (69f6d56)
  • professions: add GPT 6.1 Terra as a secondary option (1b94764)
  • user-skills: register skill bases for agent launches (1977866)
  • grpc: expand community RPC coverage and extract scheduling (4ce0b58)
  • grpc: expose remaining REST resources over gRPC-Web (b8758bc)
  • codebuddy-steering: route follow-ups into active runs (1a8d3b3)
  • system-info-grpc: serve system info over gRPC-Web (e9a187e)
  • agent-launch: log skills and secure Claude debug files (7b26e8c)
  • monospecs: manage repository clones and checkout removal (b6be963)
  • agent-limits: apply configurable CPU quotas to agent CLIs (7477f2b)
  • chat: return project-scoped proposal prompts (91e6d2f)
  • omp-steering: route follow-ups into active OMP runs (6ad9599)
  • pi-steering: route follow-ups into active Pi CLI runs (f027b27)
  • opencode-steering: route follow-ups into active OpenCode runs (68716ee)
  • opencode-provider: support steer delivery during streamed runs (edbe23b)

HagiCode-org/web

  • proposal-import: import existing OpenSpec changes into proposals (ae179aa)
  • hero-avatar: add previewed multi-hero avatar rotation (8d1372b)
  • conversation-header: animate compact session identity (8034d81)
  • hero-avatar: refresh bundled provider portrait catalog (7a87dc8)
  • hero-avatar: add provider themed portrait series to gallery (d9958ff)
  • hagitask: replace game icons with lazy loaded Lucide icons (ab27890)
  • hero-selection: animate selected heroes into new sessions (bdbd301)
  • hero-avatar: retire old packs with safe display fallbacks (80b888b)
  • conversation: replace tool summaries with a compact call ledger (a387c25)
  • ui: morph state icons across the shared controls (69ae33f)
  • skill-gallery: manage user skill bases from the local tab (bafe84d)
  • conversation: position opened sessions at the latest entry (01286fb)
  • kanban: emphasize command tile titles and progress (be813fe)
  • grpc-sessions: move session workflows to generated RPCs (c37884c)
  • grpc-community: migrate community and automation RPCs (7a2f8ee)
  • grpc-hero: move hero and achievement calls to RPC (949f639)
  • grpc-project: move workspace and Git calls to RPC (acd017b)
  • grpc-config: move configuration calls to generated RPCs (1010e64)
  • grpc-platform: move platform operations to RPC (8c39ee8)
  • grpc: add shared generated client foundation (75872fc)
  • grpc: load system info over gRPC-Web (e022bb7)
  • settings: add per-agent CPU resource-limit controls (3eea968)
  • kanban: reset command wall to selected project (3f28f74)
  • preset-tasks: spotlight default and quick-submit heroes (fbe92b8)
  • proposal: send skill prompts through the chat composer (531a7a8)
  • kanban: remove the Other group from command session sidebar (2796541)

Fixes

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • session-dispatch: dequeue messages before run activation (c475279)
  • session-dispatch: retry pending messages after SQLite contention (894e6c5)
  • sqlite-uow: avoid transactions across grain and file I/O (889a83d)
  • omniroute: ignore refresh time when detecting catalog changes (10244a8)
  • proposal: pass the chosen language into automatic planning (63b3acc)
  • prompts: ignore OpenSpec prefix parameters during validation (c49e271)
  • agent-cli: skip unconfigured providers during health probes (9969d08)
  • logging: suppress duplicate EF transaction error log events (76bf35d)
  • grpc: normalize REST values for strict protobuf JSON parsing (1fd639a)
  • system-info-grpc: enable gRPC-Web for mapped services (cb43b4c)
  • system-info-grpc: support browser gRPC-Web calls (9b3151c)
  • scheduled-plans: require a task identifier for HagiTask plans (ae3d2c6)

HagiCode-org/web

  • config-sync: skip writes for unchanged theme reconciliation (f1b1057)
  • git: report auto-commit status failures and refresh capacity (65581c0)
  • header-agenda: show today through the next three days (14c3ffd)
  • kanban: reset the global wall across all projects (a84b3f8)
  • grpc-session: normalize chat request payloads before RPC (0504f69)
  • preset-task: expand the hero picker to a full-screen sheet (747bb58)
  • hero-loadout: place built-in skills after loadout sections (a5dc964)
  • layout: preserve global view when opening a project Git tab (8502ddb)
